hero.title: Elevating Vietnamese ingredients for global food & beverage supply chains
hero.subtitle: Whitehorse Foodtech connects sourcing, R&D and product development, quality management, and the right manufacturing capacity to build ingredient solutions that are consistent, adaptable and ready for international markets.

origin.title: Our story
paragraphs: Vietnam is home to a rich, diverse range of agricultural raw materials. But turning a local ingredient into a product that meets the standards of international food and beverage brands takes more than a good source of supply.

The product has to be developed for the right application, controlled against clear specifications, produced consistently, and backed by documentation that matches the requirements of each destination market.

Whitehorse Foodtech exists to connect those pieces into a single, coordinated process. We bring together sourcing, R&D capability, quality management, the right manufacturing partners and export operations to turn the potential of Vietnamese ingredients into solutions that can be commercialized at international scale.

Rather than starting from a fixed product, we start from what the customer actually needs: what application the product serves, what standards it has to meet, how it should be packaged, and what's required to enter the target market.

valueCreation.title: How we create value
valueCreation.subtitle: A good ingredient solution has to balance four things: the right source, a product built for its application, consistent quality, and the ability to commercialize it efficiently.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.tagline: Green beans, roasted, powder, extract & cold brew
coffee.description: Sourced from Vietnam's Central Highlands, our coffee is graded by screen size, moisture content and defect count to match international buyer specifications — available as green beans and roasted whole/ground coffee, plus deeper-processed lines: soluble coffee powder, liquid coffee extract and ready-to-drink cold brew concentrate.
specs: Robusta: Screen 16/18, moisture 12.5% max, black & broken 3–5% max
Arabica: Screen 15+, moisture 12% max, fully washed or natural process
Processed lines: spray-dried/freeze-dried soluble powder, cold-extracted liquid coffee extract, unsweetened cold brew concentrate — custom concentration and packaging on request
Packaging: 60kg jute bags with GrainPro liner (green beans); pouches, drums or bag-in-box for powder/extract/cold brew
Custom roasting, formulation and private-label packaging available

fruitPowder.name: Freeze-Dried Fruit Powder
fruitPowder.tagline: Passion fruit, orange, mango, soursop, durian, dragon fruit
fruitPowder.description: Freeze-drying locks in color, aroma and nutrients far better than spray- or heat-drying, producing a fine, stable powder ideal for formulated food and beverage products.
specs: Fruits: passion fruit, orange, mango, soursop, durian, dragon fruit (custom fruits on request)
Moisture: 3–5% max for extended shelf stability
Mesh size: 80–100 mesh standard, custom particle size on request
Packaging: aluminum foil bags with desiccant, 1kg–25kg, bulk drums available

agriRaw.name: Premium Agri Raw Materials
agriRaw.tagline: Cashew, pepper, cinnamon, star anise & spices
agriRaw.description: Vietnam is among the world's leading exporters of cashew nuts, black pepper, cinnamon and star anise — we supply export-grade lots with full documentation for food manufacturing and spice trading partners.
specs: Black pepper: 500–570 g/l density, moisture 13% max, steam-sterilized on request
Cinnamon (cassia): whole quills, broken, or ground, oil content graded
Star anise: whole or split, sun-dried, export moisture standard

steps.title: 1. Sourcing

steps.title: 4. Packing

steps.title: 5. Export Documentation

steps.title: 6. Shipping & Delivery
